caption: The drawing depicts a stylized figure standing on a rectangular base. The figure has a pointed, crown-like black hairstyle and a face with a prominent nose, goatee, and emphasized cheekbones, rendered in light beige and tan shades with black outlines. The figure's arms are bent at the elbows, and the hands are slightly clenched. The upper body apparel is black, while an off-white, sleeveless robe or garment with a decorative scalloped and dotted hemline drapes over the shoulders and extends to the ankles. The lower part of the outfit appears to be a dark brown or black skirt or pants. The rectangular base is beige with triangular and diamond-shaped patterns in black along the front edge. The background is plain and off-white. The number "39" appears in small text in the bottom left corner.
title: Plate 39: Saint John Nepomuk: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
